meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Matched the evaluated HTTP 503, opaque trace ID and saved-turn replay to the Support controller, transcript and observability guide. The owner sign-in update leaves both agent routes intact.

auth.review_note: Verified configured owner authentication, session regeneration and flash persistence before native response finalization and confirmed other login paths retain their routes.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the downloaded file resolver and schema field against the source contracts for product orders and payments. This route uses the authored page publication and enquiry grant.

content.review_note: Matched the published Support article contact link with the failure reference customers see. Compared the preserved authored-page download guide with the current revision, membership and grant checks.

foundation.review_note: Compared the hosted page fields and private immutable binaries with the application and host storage contracts, deployment backup instructions, campaign-only SQL timestamp normalization and actual direct-path denial.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed Support failure rendering in the shared public layout against the frontend guide. The Google public head and separate owner reporting controls retain their documented paths.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the front-controller and Apache path guards, private resolution and upload errors with the shared request-boundary documentation.

interface.review_note: Compared the selectable Support reference and separate contact action with Design. The public layout and protected-download view retain their current control placement and shared reading styles.

mail.review_note: Compared the single configured-owner security notice with the existing claim and settlement rules. Supported SAPIs finish the stored-session response before entering the same mail path.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Reviewed the independent private download storage against the existing owner Media Library, header image and deletion documentation. Download files keep their own private root.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the published Support guide, reference and contact flow. Reviewed the owner Pages guide for protected downloads and the auth guide for the configured-owner session and notice sequence.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the new public HTTP route with the MCP capability and discoverability contracts. Campaign assets do not extend the existing agent tool surface.

remote-commerce.review_note: Compared the Support reference against the shared layout, Design and native cart and checkout recovery. Existing payment actions and session capability handling are preserved.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the Support frontend skill against the targeted desktop and phone browser fixture and documentation review procedures. Regenerated the repository maps and confirmed the protected-download route and owner-auth source indexes.
